  - because: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) the share of pitches the opposing starter throws with his single most-used offering (primary_pitch_share; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 47.5%, home 23.7% (this game's own values rest on: away over 8,807 pitches; home over 8,846 pitches); a gap of 23.8 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 16.3 percentage points (rung 2 of 3, the 75th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,061 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). - **the home side moneyline (+110, FanDuel)** -- [e7f41ed66082c279] event=7294e99a67c70c66b6edecf9841d4f03 selection_id=9e8d61f45a38abf0 edge_bps=None p_model_provenance=none grade=A
  - because: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's top-of-order minus bottom-of-order strength (top_minus_bottom; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away -0.003 wOBA, home 0.020 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 2,256 plate-appearance denominators; home over 983 plate-appearance denominators); a gap of 0.023 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.023 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,838 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a top-heavy order concentrates its best bats where the extra plate appearances go, and club-level pricing averages that concentration away; the weakest mechanism of the six, kept because V4 stated it before seeing its result. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome e7f41ed66082c279.)

  - because: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's top-of-order minus bottom-of-order strength (top_minus_bottom; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.013 wOBA, home 0.044 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 3,205 plate-appearance denominators; home over 744 plate-appearance denominators); a gap of 0.031 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.023 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,838 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). Pre-registered reason it should matter: a top-heavy order concentrates its best bats where the extra plate appearances go, and club-level pricing averages that concentration away; the weakest mechanism of the six, kept because V4 stated it before seeing its result. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome e7f41ed66082c279.)

- **Washington Nationals (away) moneyline (+135, LowVig.ag)** -- [11da2d044a08ac38] event=e1693becb4cbacb4b30e46c1c960d9a5 selection_id=b5670c82188aefcf edge_bps=None p_model_provenance=none grade=A
  - because: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) the share of the posted lineup holding the platoon advantage over the starter it faces (lineup_platoon_share; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 66.7%, home 22.2% (this game's own values rest on: away over 9 lineup slots; home over 9 lineup slots); a gap of 44.5 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 33.4 percentage points (rung 2 of 3, the 75th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,856 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: the classic exploitation: a lineup posted one-handed against a starter it holds the platoon advantage over gets more of its plate appearances in the favourable split than the club-level season line the market prices ever reflects. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome 11da2d044a08ac38.)
